item.title: MANUEL Unleash New Lyric Video ‘Native Temple’, Feat. Ryan Reeves
item.description: Rising progressive Latin metal force MANUEL has released the official music video for their latest single, “Native Temple,” featuring a powerful guest performance by vocalist Ryan Reeves. item.title: NORNA & LEGBITER Announce New Split EP, ‘Speedball’ Single Out Now
item.description: NORNA & LEGBITER photo credits: Pelagic Records Swedish noisemakers Norna and Legbiter have announced the release of their self-titled split EP on 20th March via Pelagic Records. item.title: AGNOSTIC FRONT Unleash Lyric Video for ‘You Say’ + Announce European Leg of “Echoes In Eternity” Tour
item.description: NYC’s legendary hardcore pioneers AGNOSTIC FRONT have released the official lyric video for “You Say”, off of their latest album, Echoes In Eternity. Ferocious and energetic, the song captures the band’s trademark spirit of defiance in the face of hypocrisy. item.title: HAUNTEES Release First Single ‘All Over Again’ from Upcoming Debut Album
item.description: Helsinki-based goth garage band Hauntees has released the first single, All Over Again, from their upcoming debut album. The hypnotic, dark-toned track draws its striking elements from post-punk as well as goth and garage rock. item.title: MØL Celebrate “Dreamcrush” Album Release with New Single/Video for ‘Hud’
item.description: Danish alt-metal luminists MØL have released their third studio album DREAMCRUSH via Nuclear Blast Records and to celebrate have unveiled new single/video, ‘Hud’. The album follows a striking sequence of singles from the brooding pull of ‘Garland‘ and the urgent drive of ‘Young‘ to the cathartic force of ‘CRUSH‘, culminating today in the release of ‘Hud’, an immersive, shadow tinged track that plunges listeners into the record’s tense otherworldly atmosphere.
